more_info.overview: Sodium erythorbate is the sodium salt of erythorbic acid; the source uses this established chemical name for the preparation. The supplied historical label is sodium erythorbin. The entry's antioxidant classification concerns food protection from oxidative deterioration. Exact identity and conditions should be established before applying another antioxidant's evaluation.
more_info.banned_in:

EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
